entity: US old (dormant) federal campaign committees' payouts, 2024 cycle
what_we_add: 189 committees paid out $8,569,194.71 in the 2024 cycle (median $1,794.61); 19.4% to candidates, parties and PACs (23.5% with loan repayments)
why: Tampa Bay Times/WTSP gives a number for the same place and measure, US zombie-campaign spending, but for about 100 campaigns since 1995 ($20M+), so window and definition can't line up with one cycle. Roll Call counts cash held, not paid out; CLC, NOTUS and the FEC notice are pattern or rule pieces; no source gives the share to candidates, parties and PACs. Rule edge: a stricter reading makes this Known pattern.
